Assam (India). The College was established in 1971 by a visionary group of local people with a noble mission to make quality higher education accessible to economically disadvantaged student .. The need for an institution of higher education in Sipajhar was keenly felt by the intellectuals of the area as many talented youngsters of the area had to abandon their dreams of higher education due to financial constraints. 🎓 Established in 1971 A pioneering institution providing higher education in Darrang district. 🏛️ Affiliated to Gauhati University Academic programs conducted under Gauhati University. 📜 UGC Recognized Approved under Sections 2(f) and 12(B). 🌱 Holistic Development Promoting academic excellence, values, and community growth. I am very appreciative that I was given the chance to enroll in Sipajhar College. I've always experienced a healthy and positive environment. Violina Kashyap Our college is a highly regarded academic center. We have access to an excellent central library there. Sipajhar College gave me numerous opportunities to develop and to explore all aspects of my abilities. Pratyashi Sarmah Our Sipajhar College is a leader among educational institutions in the surrounding area. The college has a cutting-edge library, virtual classroom halls, and highly qualified professors. This institution provides both excellent classrooms and fully functional labs for its students. The academic environment and extracurricular opportunities at this school are both exceptional. I feel lucky to be able to attend this university. Hopefully, the institution will continue to grow in stature over time. Samiran Bharadwaz Sipajhar College teaches its students to be innovative thinkers and leaders in the field of education, as well as how to succeed in a highly competitive academic environment. Bhargab Sandilya Our college has modern facilities and classrooms. There is a library at the college as well. Teachers provide a lot of encouragement. This college has provided me with an excellent learning environment and excellent academic and extracurricular opportunities. Subhash Kalita I would like to thank RUSA for providing us with adequate facilities for a bright and better education. In respect of classrooms, laboratories and well maintained toilets also we are grateful to the authorities and RUSA. We are happy at the instruments in our laboratory and would like more better instruments in future for carrying out experiments. Dimlee Saikia I am glad to inform you that the classrooms and the computer laboratory with 10 desktop computers are in very good condition and are maintained properly. I am happy to know that the Classrooms are fitted with tiles under RUSA scheme. I am also happy to know that the computers are all procured with RUSA grant. Prerana Sarma The Instruments at our department which are procured by RUSA grants are highly appreciated by us. These are very useful to all the students of the department. NRIBARAI SANKAR “The Science Block of Sipajhar College is a new and paramount addition. My department i.e. The Department of Physics has a teachers’ room, a classroom and a laboratory. All the rooms are fitted with tiles with RUSA grants. The laboratory includes all the necessary equipments procured with RUSA grant required for our 1st semester practical. The equipments are pristine and are maintained aptly. I have also enquired about the instruments used in the succeeding semesters and seniors gave a pretty decent review about each one of the instruments. Thanks to them, I can safely conclude that the laboratory instruments of the Physics Department are in their best working conditions”. Bharasha Bhatta Life as a college student is truly wonderful and enjoyable. The name of my college is Sipajhar College. College was a great learning experience for me. Comments of Guests, Visitors & Alumnae ← → Prof Bhaben Tanti, HOD Dept. of Botany, GU I have visited Sipajhar College in connection with Academic Audit. I have observed the college is dynamic and resourceful with dedicated faculty and principal.
Wish all success in forth coming NAAC peer team visit. Asraful Hussain, MLA Chenga Constituency, Assam ছিপাঝাৰ মহাবিদ্য়ালয় আভ্য়ন্তৰীণ পৰিৱেশ আৰু মহাবিদ্য়ালয়খনক আগুৱাই লৈ যাবলৈ সকলো মিলি কৰা প্ৰয়াসত আনন্দিত হৈচ্ছো । অসম বিধান সভাৰ শিক্ষা বিষয়ক স্থায়ী সমিতিৰ অধ্য়ক্ষ ড৹ পৰমানন্দ ৰাজবংশী ডাঙৰীয়াৰ জৰিয়তে আজি আমি অহা দলটো মহাবিদ্য়ালয়খন পৰিদৰ্শন কৰি সন্তুষ্টি প্ৰকাশ কৰিছে| | Dr. Binita Basnet Baruah, Director Mergen Biologics, Guwahati Thanking all the members of Sipajhar College fraternity for giving us this opportunity to interact with the students of life sciences. We look forward to this association and hope to work together in a collaboratively way towards a common goal for the welfare of student communities.
The students of the college are well informed and guiding them with proper inputs will definitely shape their future. Mergen Biologics will be happy to help in doing that Dr. Kamala Kanta Borah, Principal, Mangaldai College Happy to see the serene environment of the college. The college is moving towards massive changes in academic and other important aspects. Highly delighted to see the young enthusiastic and well coordinated faculty members. Hope, college will flourish in a more vibrant way in days to come. Best wishes for the future journey. Arzoo Dutta, Senior Consultant, National Tobacco Control Program, Assam Sipajhar College has taken impressive steps regarding Tobacco Awareness and has in place all the requisite signage in place.
The District Tobacco Control Cell has declared the college as “Tobacco Free Educational Institute” today, the 26/10/22.
It is the responsibility of the college administration and students to sustain the status and maintain the “ToFEI” scoreboard. Best regards and good wishes. Dr. Pratyushman Hazarika, Lecturer, Government Dental College, Dibrugarh Appreciation for the infrastructure and initiatives towards extraordinary education. Dr. Buddhin Ch. Hazarika, Retired principal, Kharupetia College Green campus, excellent infrastructure and excellent environment for imparting higher education at college level. Prof Dandadhar Sarma, Department of Zoology, Gauhati University I am very much thankful to the organizers of today’s meeting as well as Principal and teaching members for inviting me to show my experience. I feel the college has already taken the momentum. Mr. Tridip Boruah, Assistant Professor, Department of Botany , M.C. College প্ৰথম্তে আপোনালোকক ধন্য়বাদ , ইমান সুন্দৰ এটি অনুস্থানত আমাক ক্থা কোৱাৰ সুবিধা প্ৰদান কৰাৰ কাৰণে । আপোনালকৰ আতিথ্য় আৰু আপ্য়ায়্নত আমি মুগ্ধ । কেচুসাৰ প্ৰস্তুত কৰাৰ সকলো ধৰণৰ কাৰিকৰী প্ৰচেষ্টাত আমি ছিপাঝাৰ কলেকক সহায় কৰাৰ প্ৰতিশ্ৰুতি প্ৰদান কৰিলো । শোভেচ্ছা আৰু শুভকামনাৰে… Prof Utpal Sarma, Department of Instrumentation & USIC, GU All members are very energetic. The college has a very bright future indeed. Dr. Mridul Kumar Sarma, MS, Fellow in FHNO (Oncology) Beautiful College with a nice and well maintained campus. God bless the College. Dr. Nirmal Kr. Beria, General Medicine Doctor It’s my very great privilege to be a part of World Cancer Day 2020, awareness and screening event. Sincere thanks to the principal Dr Deka as well as the college fraternity for their dedicated efforts to make the event a successful one. The college complex is neat, clean and hygienic. The students have enthusiastically and sincerely participated in the rally as well as in the awareness meeting. I wish this healthy atmosphere continues in the future too. Prof Tarini Kumar Dutta, Former Head, Department of Mathematics, GU I have come today to this college without any specific purpose, but the hospitality, academic dynamism with strong vision of the principal Dr. P. Deka and academic discussion with a number of faculty has impressed me greatly. The construction with solid foundation , taxonomy & evolving nature, classroom, teacher room, library, conference hall, surrounding gardens and the whole campus how attracted me a lot, and under the healthy atmosphere, the college has been progressing in a scientific way in order of achieve the principal goals of higher education, viz, knowledge, creativity, logical thinking, analytical reasoning, quick understanding / quick presentation, leadership quality, pe Prof Shrutidhara Chakravarty, Department of Sanskrit, GU I am very glad to be present in this beautiful college, i.e. the Sipajhar College today. I am thankful to the Principal of the college and the faculty members of the Department of English of the of college for inviting me to deliver a lecture on Indian Classical Literature.
I convey my best wishes to all the faculty members and students of this college. Dr Narewsar Sarma, Sr Consultant Surgeon, Nemcare Hospital, Guwahati Sipajhar College is now imparting knowledge and skill to the students of this region for development of their career. The students are studious and intelligent while the teachers are knowledgeable and eager to teach the students. The college has made lots of strides in its development in the recent past under the able leadership of the management.
I wish you all the very best. Jayanta Kumar Chakravarty, Retired HOD English, Tangla College Happy to be at Sipajhar College, happy to be a well-wisher of this college. The college is progressing to a higher level. Hope this journey will be meaningful, successful.
My best wishes. Prof Anurup Gohain Barua, Dept of Physics, GU Impressed by the infrastructure and environment. Best wishes to the college. Prof Jogen Ch. Kalita, Dept of Zoology & Director, UGC-HRDC, GU The IQAC has been very active and organizing many useful programs for students and the neighbourhood community. Hope, the IQAC will be able to recommend more suggestions for the overall development of the college. Prof. Diganta Kr. Dey, Dept. of Chemistry, GU College seems to have progressed a lot in a very short time. Environment is impressive. Best wishes. Prof Rudra Kumar Deka, Head, Dept. of Mathematics, GU The college has tremendous potential to become a premier institution of Darrang District. Dr. P.P. Baruah, Professor & Head, Dept. of Botany, GU I feel happy to visit the college today as a member of he joint inspection team for introduction of science stream. The college has developed a lot.
